s.src: Air-cooled chillers with free-cooling coils (air cooling): an air-cooled hall needs chilled water at about 13 °C or warmer (NREL for DOE FEMP, Best Practices Guide 2024, s. 5.2.1), and a dry cooler cannot cool water below the outdoor air (rated units leave it 3–11 K above), so chillers carry the full load in summer. genLines: 1 generator set of about 1 MW carry 0.8 MW; with spares, 2. Placed: 2 on the roof, 0 in the yard.
Each about 8.434 × 2.616 m, 3.706 m high; 1.5 m from the building, 2 m between sets (1 m clear all round, CSA C282 6.5.1.1; register arch_csa_c282).

Fuel in each set's sub-base tank: about 2400 L. In the yard: 1.5 m from the property line and 0.1 m from the building (CSA B139.1.0 Table 2; register arch_csa_b139). On a roof: at most 1,250 L a tank and 2,500 L a supply line (B139.1.1 6.5.3). FM 5-32 (insurer guidance, not law): not on the roof or in a basement.

<span class="src">Standby diesel generator sets in Sound Level 2 enclosures with sub-base tanks. Basis units: Rehlko (Kohler) KD2000, 2,000 kW standby (data-centre continuous rating the same), 13.49 × 3.49 m, up to 4.78 m high (G5-626, rev 6/24); KD1000, 1,000 kW, 8.43 × 2.62 m, 3.71 m high with the 12 h tank (G6-154, 12/23). Both EPA Tier 2, cULus (UL 2200, CSA C22.2 No. 100); manufacturer claims.
